summary: Nuveen Credit Strategies Income Fund filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing the planned retirement of portfolio manager Himani Trivedi from Nuveen on June 30, 2027; she will continue managing the Fund until October 31, 2026. Scott Caraher, James Kim and Coale Mechlin remain portfolio managers, and the Fund's investment objectives and policies are unchanged. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, premium, financing, regulatory clock or transaction mechanics are stated. This is an ordinary personnel-transition disclosure for a closed-end fund listed on the NYSE under JQC.
